### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | IJED Executive Committee published journal-specific generative-AI guidelines (Linardon et al. 2025, eat.24543, open access via PMC12703213). Disclosure required, not pre-approval: authors must disclose AI use in methods/acknowledgments; a mandatory disclosure prompt/checkbox at submission is recommended but not yet confirmed as implemented. Permitted uses are limited to low-level support (proofreading, formatting, code debugging, language correction). Prohibited: using AI to write main text or generate analytic/interpretive content, uploading identifiable/sensitive participant data, relying on AI for clinical/diagnostic judgment or lived-experience content, using AI output verbatim. Reviewers may use AI only for minor tasks (e.g., proofreading) with disclosure to editors; editors may use AI for administrative tasks (reviewer selection, plagiarism detection). Authors remain fully responsible for verifying AI-generated content. Survey backing this policy: 70% of ED researchers report using generative AI, 90% verify output, but only 1 in 3 disclose use. |
| **Source URL** | https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/eat.24543 |

### Preprint Policy

> AI-research note (not broken down per-stage): Yes, per Wiley's general (publisher-wide) preprint policy: authors may post the submitted manuscript version to a recognized preprint server (e.g., PsyArXiv, medRxiv) before or during submission; this does not guarantee peer review or acceptance. Authors must retain copyright during the preprint stage (no re-use license preferred; CC-BY/CC-BY-NC/CC-BY-NC-ND accepted). No IJED-specific preprint policy page was found distinct from this Wiley-wide policy.
> Source: https://authors.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/open-access/preprints-policy.html
